newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU's Van Miert warns UEFA on broadcasting rights.
newsitem.headline: EU's Van Miert warns UEFA on broadcasting rights.

text.p: European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert warned UEFA on Thursday the Commission would act unless European soccer's governing body changed what he called strict broadcasting conditions.
"We think UEFA conditions are too strict," Van Miert told the European Parliament's Economic and Monetary Affairs committee.
"We are in discussions with UEFA, but if there is no progress we will have to act," he said, adding that the Commission had received complaints.

He did not elaborate, but Commission sources said the complaints had been filed by television channels which broadcast UEFA matches but do not have exclusivity rights. They particularly contested UEFA's sub-licensing conditions.

This is a new setback for UEFA, which earlier this year was forced to scrap its player system and transfer rules in the wake of a landmark ruling by the European Court of Justice in case filed by Belgian footballer Jean-Marc Bosman.
